html.home.title: Olipix Maker Tools
html.home.description: Free tools for people who 3D print, from Olipix Creative Lab. They run in your browser: no account, and your files are never uploaded.
html.home.h1: Workbench tools for people who 3D print
html.home.lead: Free, open and running in your browser. Your files stay on your computer.
html.home.tryDemo: Try it with an example project
html.home.tuneP: You open your Bambu Studio project, copy a prompt to the AI you prefer and paste its answer back. You get the same project with the settings tuned for that piece.
html.home.tuneLi1: It only touches a closed list of settings, within safe ranges.
html.home.tuneLi2: It shows every change with the reason; untick what you don't want.
html.home.tuneLi3: It marks the changed settings as edited in Bambu Studio.
html.home.priceP: Filament, energy, machine time, failures, margin and VAT, with the price updating as you type.
html.home.priceLi1: Basic mode for a quick figure, Pro mode with machine time, failures, VAT and rounding.
html.home.priceLi2: Margin in % or a fixed profit, with your printer's power draw from a list.
html.home.priceLi3: Ready-to-copy text, for you or for the client.
html.home.priceFacts: Free · No account · Your values stay in your browser
html.home.trustLead: Every promise comes with a way to check it.
html.home.proof1h: Your file never leaves your computer
html.home.proof1p: Everything is calculated in the browser. Open the Network tab in your developer tools: there are no requests carrying your project. The only text that leaves is the prompt you copy, and you read it first. When you finish, you'll see one request to GoatCounter with just the tool's name: that's the counter.
html.home.proof2p: You can read, copy and adapt it. See the code on GitHub.
html.home.proof3h: Tested, and the AI's answer is never accepted blindly
html.home.proof3p: Every change is validated against your file: unknown keys, out-of-range values and purge towers switched off in multicolour projects are rejected. See the automated tests.
html.home.aboutH2: Made in the Olipix Creative Lab workshop
html.home.about1: Olipix Creative Lab is an independent studio: we design and print decorative pieces, and we like a challenge. The harder the fit or the shape, the more we want to try it.
html.home.about2: These tools were born in our own workshop. We use them to prepare projects, quote and print our pieces, and we decided to share them: people who 3D print lose hours on the same problems, and a tool that already solves one of them shouldn't stay in a drawer.
html.home.about3: We'll keep adding the ones that pass the test of daily use.
html.home.photoAlt: The workshop bench: 3D printers, shelves of filament spools and drawers.
html.home.caption: The bench where these tools are used.
html.home.footLicenceRest: The Olipix name and logo are not included.
html.tune.title: Tune 3MF — Olipix Maker Tools
html.tune.description: Fine-tune the settings of a Bambu Studio project with the help of your AI, without uploading the file.
html.tune.lead: Open a Bambu Studio project (unsliced), copy the prompt to the AI you prefer, paste its answer and download the -tuned.3mf. The file never leaves the browser; only the prompt text does, and you can read it before copying.
html.tune.demo: Try it with an example project
html.tune.drop: Drop the .3mf here or click to choose
html.tune.notesPh: e.g. it has to fit into another piece with a 0.2 mm gap
html.tune.promptIntro: Copy this into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or a local model. Check the text: it is everything that will be sent.
html.tune.replyIntro: Paste the AI's answer here (the JSON).
html.tune.afterDownload: Open the file in Bambu Studio: the changed settings show up marked as edited. Slice it there.
html.price.title: Price calculator — Olipix Maker Tools
html.price.description: How much to charge for a 3D-printed piece: filament, energy, machine time, failures, margin and VAT. Live price, in your browser.
html.price.lead: How much to charge for a 3D-printed piece. Weight and time come from the slicer; the rest are your costs. The price updates as you type and your values stay in this browser only.
html.price.proHint: Machine time, failures, VAT, several pieces
html.price.name: Name (optional)
html.price.pieceHint: Weight and time for the whole plate, as the slicer shows them. With several pieces, the price is split between them.
html.price.costsHint: The starting values are just a starting point: replace them with your own. The draws in the list are approximate averages while printing PLA; other materials or a cold room use more. A power meter plug gives the real value; the energy price is on your electricity bill.
html.price.profitMargin: Margin in % on top of cost
html.price.empty: Fill in the weight or the time and the price shows up here.

js.prompt.system:
You are an expert in FDM 3D printing with Bambu Studio. You receive the current settings of a project,
the printer, the filament, what the piece is for and the priority. Suggest only the changes that are really
worth making for this piece, at most 10, each with a short reason in English.
Use only keys that appear in "settings" and respect each one's "allowed" (range or list).
"use" and "priority" outrank everything else. On a decorative piece or a miniature, or with a quality
priority, don't lower the fan or raise the temperature to gain strength: that makes bridges, overhangs and
fine text worse. Only suggest strength changes when the use is functional or outdoor, or the priority is
strength.
With more than one entry in "filaments" (several colours), never switch off the prime tower (enable_prime_tower).
Don't suggest changing a key that every object overrides in "per_object_overrides": it would have no effect.
"plates" shows the objects on each plate. Changes apply to the whole project, on every plate: pick values
that suit them all and, if one plate needs something else, say so in "note".
If nothing needs changing, return an empty list.
Always write one or two short sentences in "note": why these changes (or none), and one optional change that
was left out, if any, with the reason.
Reply with JSON only, no text around it: {"note":"...","changes":[{"key":"layer_height","value":"0.16","reason":"..."}]}
js.prompt.notJson: The answer wasn't JSON. Ask the AI to reply with the JSON only.
js.prompt.noList: The answer has no "changes" list. Ask the AI to reply in the format given.
js.price.marginObtained: Margin achieved: {pct}% on top of cost
js.price.copyManual: Select the text and copy it by hand.
js.price.empty: Fill in the weight or the time and the price shows up here.
